claim.supported_scope: Direct, total indirect, and total-effect decomposition across directed paths in a supported recursive PLS model, descriptive mediation-pattern labels, variance accounted for when defined, and matching bootstrap inference for emitted indirect-effect identities.
claim.estimand: For each ordered construct pair, the direct path coefficient, the sum of products over all directed mediated paths, their total, and the indirect-to-total ratio when the total is not numerically zero.
assumptions: The structural graph is recursive and every reported mediated path is composed only of estimated directed structural edges.
Effect decomposition uses the same converged PLS result and construct orientation as the saved run.
Publication inference is attached only when its indirect-effect identity, recipe, dataset fingerprint, seed, and method versions match the point estimate.
exclusions: Causal identification, unmeasured-confounding correction, longitudinal mediation, and counterfactual mediation effects are excluded.
Moderated mediation, observed-variable PROCESS templates, and cyclic or reciprocal mediation are separate capabilities.
Descriptive VAF labels are not substituted for qualified uncertainty intervals.
warnings: A nonzero indirect point estimate does not establish mediation without design assumptions and qualified uncertainty evidence.
The descriptive class label does not determine causal mechanism, practical importance, or publication suitability.

equations.expression: indirect_ij = sum_{p in P_ij, length(p) >= 2} product_{e in p} beta_e
total_ij = direct_ij + indirect_ij; VAF_ij = indirect_ij / total_ij when abs(total_ij) > 1e-12

references.citation: Nitzl, Roldan, and Cepeda (2016), Mediation Analysis in Partial Least Squares Path Modeling, Industrial Management and Data Systems 116(9), 1849-1864
Independent standardized OLS and path-product mediation fixture
Independent development-only R base-lm mediation fixture

simulations.design: Single, parallel, and serial mediation graphs over bounded loading, path, sample-size, reliability, and nonnormality grids.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen scenario-indexed data and bootstrap streams; replicate identity is independent of worker count and completion order.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Point decompositions must match an independent path-product reference within 1e-6 and preregistered indirect-effect interval coverage must pass with every failure retained.

simulations.design: Graphs with one broken mediation stage while retaining bounded direct and nuisance structural effects.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen indexed null scenarios and resampling streams shared only by scenario identity.
simulations.acceptance_rule: The preregistered false-positive confidence interval must contain the nominal level and descriptive class labels must reflect the frozen tolerance exactly.

boundaries.case: The PLS model cannot estimate one or more edges required for a requested indirect path.
boundaries.expected_behavior: No completed mediation estimate is emitted; the underlying estimation failure remains explicit.

boundaries.case: The requested effect relies on a cycle, reciprocal path, unsupported generated construct, or moderated stage.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The graph is blocked or the unsupported effect is excluded with an explicit scope message.

boundaries.case: Rows, constructs, indicators, or independent path declaration order are consistently permuted.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Mapped direct, indirect, total, VAF, class, and matching inference rows remain equal within tolerance.

boundaries.case: The same mediation bootstrap recipe is run repeatedly with different supported worker counts.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Resample plans, effect identities, intervals, probabilities, and aggregate order are exactly equal.

boundaries.case: A path, effect identity, decomposition, class, interval, seed, or method version is altered.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict project validation rejects the archive rather than displaying the changed mediation result.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject a result whose mediation capability identity differs from its recipe.
Reject a mediation payload relabeled with another method version.
Reject a mediation result whose dataset fingerprint no longer matches.
Reject any modified archive member whose checksum differs.
Reject duplicate keys, unknown fields, non-finite effects, invalid classes, or decompositions inconsistent with saved paths.
Never reinterpret unversioned path products or inference from another effect identity as current mediation evidence.

persistence.legacy_policy: Only pls_mediation_v1 effect identities regenerated or strictly loaded under the current recipe contract may satisfy current evidence.

native.gui_cli_parity_rule: For the same model, data fingerprint, resampling plan, seed, and method versions, GUI and CLI mediation and inference payloads must be exactly equal apart from operational identifiers and timestamps.
accessibility_rules: All decompositions, labels, intervals, and unavailable reasons are available in accessible tables.
Effect identity and uncertainty are understandable without diagram position, color, or pointer interaction.
